The data we collect, and why

The information we collect depends on how you interact with the service.

If you only browse

We generally do not intentionally collect directly identifying personal information from casual visitors. Limited technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information and request metadata may be processed by our infrastructure and security providers for hosting, delivery, caching, abuse prevention and security monitoring.

If you create an account

We may collect your email address, an encrypted password hash, authentication credentials, your preferences, and timestamps and activity records. We use this to authenticate users, operate accounts, personalise the service, maintain security and communicate with you.

If you chat to {{AI_NAME}}

We may store your messages, {{AI_NAME}}'s responses, conversation history, temporary identifiers and technical metadata associated with the interaction. This lets the assistant maintain continuity, apply usage limits, improve reliability, monitor abuse and maintain service quality.

If you purchase a membership

Payments are processed directly by our payment provider. We do not receive or store full payment card details. We may store customer and subscription identifiers, billing metadata, subscription status, and renewal and expiry dates.

If you upload documents

Uploaded documents are stored in a private account-linked environment. Depending on the feature we may store original files, extracted text, redacted text, summaries and outputs, and processing metadata. Please avoid uploading highly sensitive or third-party confidential data unless you are legally authorised to do so.

Sharing with third-party providers

We share limited personal data with the service providers that help us run the service, such as hosting, infrastructure, authentication, payments, AI processing and security. They act on our instructions under contract. We do not sell your personal data. Our providers include {{PROCESSORS}}.

Some providers may process data outside {{JURISDICTION}}. Where they do, international transfers are protected using appropriate safeguards, and {{DP_LAW}} restricts such transfers unless adequate protection exists.

How we use your data

We use personal data to provide and operate the service, authenticate users, process memberships and payments, improve the service, analyse usage and performance, personalise communications, maintain security and detect abuse, investigate fraud, comply with legal obligations, and enforce our terms.

Where reasonably possible we use anonymised, aggregated or pseudonymised data for research and product development. Where data has been irreversibly anonymised so individuals are no longer identifiable, it may no longer constitute personal data under {{DP_LAW}}.

Where required by applicable law, we rely on lawful processing grounds including consent, performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, and legitimate interests in operating, securing and improving the service.

Data retention

We retain data only for as long as reasonably necessary for operational purposes, legal compliance, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, security, backup and recovery, and legitimate business administration. Retention periods vary by feature and legal obligation.
